name: @tee-agent/contracts
description: Solidity contracts for the tee-agent (ERC-8004, ERC-7857)

scripts.deploy:local: yes | hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/Deploy.ts --network localhost --reset && npm run replace-tee:local
scripts.deploy:baseSepolia: yes | hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/Deploy.ts --network baseSepolia --verify --parameters ignition/parameters.baseSepolia.json && npm run setup-env
scripts.deploy:base: yes | hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/Deploy.ts --network base --verify --parameters ignition/parameters.base.json && npm run setup-env
